## GOVERNMENT OF ANDHRA PRADESH ABSTRACT Health, Medical & Family Welfare Department – APMSIDC - Establishment of New Government Medical Colleges - Minutes of the Review Meeting of Hon’ble Chief Minister on Health Department held on 12.08.2024 - Constitution of Committee for finalization of safe level closure of structures for the New Medical Colleges taken up under Phase - 2 & 3 to work out PPP models – Committee Constituted -Orders – Issued. ## HEALTH, MEDICAL & FAMILY WELFARE (H2) DEPARTMENT Dated: 23-01-2025 Read the following: G.O.RT.No. 27 1. 1 Proposal of the MD, APMSIDC, File bearing Computer No.2613029. 2. 2 Govt., Memo.No.2613029/H2/2024, HM&FW(H2) Department, dt.04.01.2025. 3. >>>> ORDER: In the circumstances reported by the MD, APMSIDC in the reference 1st read above, the Government after careful examination of the matter, hereby constitute a committee with the following members for conducting the physical inspection of different structures under execution of (9) New Medical Colleges (Phase –II Medical Colleges i.e., Markapuram, Madanapalli, Pulivendula and Adoni & Phase- III Medical Colleges i.e., Narsipatnam, Amalapuram, Palakollu, Bapatla and Penudgonda).
1 Managing Director, APMSIDC : Chairman
2 Director of Medical Education : Member
3 Engineer-in-Chief (R&B) Buildings : Member
4 Engineer-in-Chief (Irrigation Dept) : Member
5 Chief Engineer, (R&B) Electrical : Member
6 Chief Engineer, APIIC : Member
7 Chief Engineer, APMSIDC : Member /
Convener
2. The Committee shall conduct the physical inspection along with the authorized representative of the respective Contracting Agency, by taking Photographs and Videos of the works executed in different blocks in each Medical College and submit a report accordingly. 3. The MD, APMSIDC is requested to submit the financial implication after finalization of the Committee report to the Government for taking a decision on safe closure of the agreements.
